trap-negation-contrast.notes: RIGOR (reported, not fixed). PROPER-NAME CORRUPTION: the block writes 'the classical Framed-Robinson-Thrall identity'. The result is the Frame-Robinson-Thrall hook-length formula (J. S. Frame, G. de B. Robinson, R. M. Thrall, 1954) — 'Frame', not 'Framed'. Corpus-grepped: every other occurrence in the tree spells it correctly (wedderburn-weight-canonical.md, five docstrings in lean/QOU/Mathlib/WenzlBridgeConcrete.lean, four docs/audits files, computations/probes/wedderburn_weight_canonical_probe.py and its witness); this block is the SOLE 'Framed-' site in content/, docs/ and computations/, so it is a single-site corruption, not a corpus convention. Proposed fix: 'Framed-Robinson-Thrall' -> 'Frame-Robinson-Thrall'. SECOND ITEM, unverifiable as written: 'replaces seven disparate mass-formula corrections' gives a count with no cross-reference; the Bethe-Weizsaecker form this section modifies carries five terms (volume, surface, Coulomb, asymmetry, pairing), so the seven need naming or the count needs dropping.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: Roadmap prose throughout ('The sequence begins ... The derivation subsequently ... The section concludes'); no setup-then-reframe. NOTE: 'The structural pivot links the Wedderburn weights ...' uses 'pivot' as a technical noun, not as the rhetorical construction.

trap-em-dash.evidence: Zero em-dashes; the block uses commas and participials instead.

trap-triples.evidence: Two three-item lists inside consecutive sentences of the final paragraph: 'the Schur-Weyl decomposition, the generating function structure, and the exact pole behavior of the mass trace' then 'magic-shell corrections, Borromean composites, and Pauli exclusions'. Paragraph 2 adds a third implicit triad (decomposition / pivot / spectrum, one per sentence). Concentration, not presence, is the tell here.
trap-triples.notes: Proposed (structural, not applied): the two lists enumerate real downstream blocks, so keep the content but break the parallelism — fold the second list into a sentence naming what the synthesis produces rather than listing three nouns, or merge the two sentences so only one triad carries the roadmap.

'This section translates ...', 'The section concludes by ...' is section-intro roadmapping, which is standard scholarly practice, not narration of the author's own emphasis. No 'note the framing' / 'we emphasize'.

trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: Each paragraph advances the roadmap; the last does not restate the first.

trap-superlative.evidence: Unqualified strength claims stacked in a single sentence: 'replaces seven disparate mass-formula corrections with a single unified framework, projecting the beta-stability valley naturally as the level set'. 'disparate', 'single unified', 'naturally' each inflate; 'translating the categorical trace cleanly' and 'links ... directly' repeat the pattern. The count 'seven' is asserted with no cross-reference (the Bethe-Weizsaecker form the block modifies has five terms), so the strongest word in the sentence is also the least supported.
trap-superlative.notes: Proposed (structural — the sentence carries a load-bearing numeric claim, so not fixed inline): either cite the seven corrections being replaced or drop the count; and reduce 'a single unified framework' to 'one recursion'. Also drop 'naturally' and 'cleanly', which assert ease rather than result.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: Sustained noun-and-participle chains that stall aloud: 'A character-ratio decomposition per jet level drives the binding mechanism'; 'the decomposition coefficient represents the LP-dual variable of a Frobenius-positivity constraint, driven by the elementary symmetric polynomials in the Jucys-Murphy elements'; 'explicitly tracking the Wedderburn volume deviations across jet levels'; 'deploying the Macdonald hook telescope to explicitize the coefficients'. Six of the block's nine sentences end in a trailing participial clause, and 'explicitize' is not a word in the corpus's register.
trap-nonspeakable.notes: Proposed (structural): give the participial tails finite verbs and split the 40-word sentences; replace 'explicitize' with 'make explicit'.
